import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix

from catboost import CatBoostClassifier

sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (10, 6)

BASE_DIR = Path.cwd().resolve().parent if Path.cwd().name == 'notebooks' else Path.cwd()
DATA_PATH = BASE_DIR / 'data' / 'raw' / 'Churn_Modelling.csv'

print('BASE_DIR =', BASE_DIR)
print('DATA_PATH =', DATA_PATH)
## 1. Загрузка данных
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
df.head()

print('Размер датасета:', df.shape)
print('\nТипы данных:')
print(df.dtypes)
df.info()
## 2. Первичный анализ качества данных
missing = df.isnull().sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
missing
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()
print('Количество дубликатов:', duplicates)
df.describe(include='all').T
## 3. Анализ целевой переменной

target_counts = df['Exited'].value_counts()
target_ratio = df['Exited'].value_counts(normalize=True)

print('Распределение классов:')
print(target_counts)
print('\nДоли классов:')
print(target_ratio)

sns.countplot(data=df, x='Exited')
plt.title('Распределение целевой переменной Exited')
plt.xlabel('Exited')
plt.ylabel('Количество')
plt.show()
## 4. Подготовка списка признаков

drop_columns = ['RowNumber', 'CustomerId', 'Surname']
target = 'Exited'

numeric_features = [
    'CreditScore', 'Age', 'Tenure', 'Balance',
    'NumOfProducts', 'EstimatedSalary'
]

categorical_features = ['Geography', 'Gender']
binary_features = ['HasCrCard', 'IsActiveMember']

all_features = numeric_features + categorical_features + binary_features

print('Числовые признаки:', numeric_features)
print('Категориальные признаки:', categorical_features)
print('Бинарные признаки:', binary_features)
## 5. Очистка данных

df_clean = df.drop(columns=drop_columns).drop_duplicates().copy()
print('Размер после очистки:', df_clean.shape)
df_clean.head()
## 6. Анализ числовых признаков

df_clean[numeric_features].hist(bins=20, figsize=(14, 10))
plt.suptitle('Распределения числовых признаков', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

for col in numeric_features:
    plt.figure()
    sns.boxplot(x=df_clean[col])
    plt.title(f'Boxplot: {col}')
    plt.show()

corr = df_clean[numeric_features + [target]].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', fmt='.2f')
plt.title('Корреляционная матрица')
plt.show()
## 7. Анализ категориальных и бинарных признаков

for col in categorical_features + binary_features:
    plt.figure()
    sns.countplot(data=df_clean, x=col, hue=target)
    plt.title(f'Распределение {col} относительно Exited')
    plt.xticks(rotation=15)
    plt.show()
## 8. Подготовка train/val/test

X = df_clean[all_features]
y = df_clean[target]

random_state = 42
test_size = 0.15
val_size = 0.15

X_train_full, X_test, y_train_full, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y,
    test_size=test_size,
    stratify=y,
    random_state=random_state
)

val_ratio_from_train = val_size / (1 - test_size)

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full,
    test_size=val_ratio_from_train,
    stratify=y_train_full,
    random_state=random_state
)

print('Train shape:', X_train.shape)
print('Val shape:', X_val.shape)
print('Test shape:', X_test.shape)
## 9. Baseline: Logistic Regression

num_pipe = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='median')),
    ('scaler', StandardScaler())
])

cat_pipe = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
    ('onehot', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'))
])

bin_pipe = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent'))
])

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ('num', num_pipe, numeric_features),
    ('cat', cat_pipe, categorical_features),
    ('bin', bin_pipe, binary_features)
])

baseline_model = Pipeline([
    ('preprocessor', preprocessor),
    ('model', LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced'))
])

baseline_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

baseline_pred = baseline_model.predict(X_test)
baseline_proba = baseline_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

baseline_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, baseline_pred)
baseline_f1 = f1_score(y_test, baseline_pred)
baseline_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, baseline_proba)

print('Baseline Logistic Regression')
print('Accuracy:', round(baseline_accuracy, 4))
print('F1-score:', round(baseline_f1, 4))
print('ROC-AUC:', round(baseline_auc, 4))
print(classification_report(y_test, baseline_pred))

cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, baseline_pred)
sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Blues')
plt.title('Confusion Matrix: Logistic Regression')
plt.xlabel('Predicted')
plt.ylabel('Actual')
plt.show()
## 10. Улучшенная модель: CatBoost (базовые параметры)

X_train_cat = X_train.copy()
X_val_cat = X_val.copy()
X_test_cat = X_test.copy()

cat_features_idx = [X_train_cat.columns.get_loc(col) for col in categorical_features]

catboost_base = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=150,
    depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    loss_function='Logloss',
    eval_metric='AUC',
    random_seed=42,
    verbose=False
)

catboost_base.fit(
    X_train_cat, y_train,
    cat_features=cat_features_idx,
    eval_set=(X_val_cat, y_val),
    use_best_model=True
)

cat_base_pred = catboost_base.predict(X_test_cat).astype(int)
cat_base_proba = catboost_base.predict_proba(X_test_cat)[:, 1]

cat_base_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, cat_base_pred)
cat_base_f1 = f1_score(y_test, cat_base_pred)
cat_base_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, cat_base_proba)

print('CatBoost Base')
print('Accuracy:', round(cat_base_accuracy, 4))
print('F1-score:', round(cat_base_f1, 4))
print('ROC-AUC:', round(cat_base_auc, 4))
## 11. Финальная модель: CatBoost (тюнинг гиперпараметров)

catboost_final = CatBoostClassifier(
    iterations=300,
    depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    loss_function='Logloss',
    eval_metric='AUC',
    random_seed=42,
    verbose=False
)

catboost_final.fit(
    X_train_cat, y_train,
    cat_features=cat_features_idx,
    eval_set=(X_val_cat, y_val),
    use_best_model=True
)

cat_final_pred = catboost_final.predict(X_test_cat).astype(int)
cat_final_proba = catboost_final.predict_proba(X_test_cat)[:, 1]

cat_final_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, cat_final_pred)
cat_final_f1 = f1_score(y_test, cat_final_pred)
cat_final_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, cat_final_proba)

print('CatBoost Final')
print('Accuracy:', round(cat_final_accuracy, 4))
print('F1-score:', round(cat_final_f1, 4))
print('ROC-AUC:', round(cat_final_auc, 4))
## 12. Сравнение моделей

results = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        'Модель / конфигурация': 'Baseline',
        'Описание': 'Logistic Regression, стандартные фичи',
        'Accuracy': round(baseline_accuracy, 4),
        'F1-score': round(baseline_f1, 4),
        'ROC-AUC': round(baseline_auc, 4),
        'Комментарий': 'Стартовая модель'
    },
    {
        'Модель / конфигурация': 'Model A',
        'Описание': 'CatBoost, базовые параметры',
        'Accuracy': round(cat_base_accuracy, 4),
        'F1-score': round(cat_base_f1, 4),
        'ROC-AUC': round(cat_base_auc, 4),
        'Комментарий': 'Лучше baseline'
    },
    {
        'Модель / конфигурация': 'Model B',
        'Описание': 'CatBoost, тюнинг гиперпараметров',
        'Accuracy': round(cat_final_accuracy, 4),
        'F1-score': round(cat_final_f1, 4),
        'ROC-AUC': round(cat_final_auc, 4),
        'Комментарий': 'Финальная модель'
    }
])

results
## 13. Выводы
